_comment: The 'p'-as-dot version decode. Two kinds of row: the UNIT rows probe decodePNotationVersion directly (token -> decoded form, or must-fail for a token that must NOT decode), and the CATALOG rows pin every digit-p-digit model id in the committed registry to the entity key it resolves to. The catalog set is the 14 digit-p-digit ids (all from fireworks-ai and kimi-for-coding; a census sweep asserts that confinement separately) plus one non-p glued-generation regression control. See TESTING.md. RETIRED 2026-07-23 snapshot refresh: the kimi-for-coding k2p5/k2p6/k2p7 ids left the upstream catalog (provider replaced its listing); their three rows are retired with the ids, and the k2p7 exact-id override is removed from parse.go. The fireworks kimi-k2p* rows remain and still pin the p-as-dot decode for the kimi family.
